# GM Mohit - Portfolio and AI Context

This is the portfolio of GM Mohit, a Creative Developer and UI/UX Designer who specializes in building highly aesthetic, brutalist, and physics-driven digital experiences.

## Core Identity
- **Name:** GM Mohit
- **Roles:** Creative Developer, UI/UX Architect, Digital Craftsman
- **Website:** https://www.gmmohit.com
- **Philosophy:** "I build digital experiences where elegance meets intention. I help ambitious brands break through the noise with design that performs as well as it looks."

## Services & Expertise
1. **Strategy & Direction:** Defining core purpose and pathways to elevate digital presence.
2. **Visual Design:** Creating pixel-perfect, brutalist, and highly aesthetic interfaces that demand attention.
3. **Creative Development:** Bringing static pixels to life with physics-driven motion and precise, considered implementation.

## Technical Stack
- Next.js & React
- Framer Motion (Physics & Interaction)
- Tailwind CSS

## Location
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (GMT +5:30). Available for projects worldwide.

## Case Studies
- Teaure — e-commerce UX, brand and motion design: https://www.gmmohit.com/works/teaure
